name: Lulu
notes: Casts go one at a time: Glitterlance has a real 0.25 s cast time (its damage lands at the cast, then Lulu is busy until the cast time ends); self-cast Whimsy is instant (its 0.2419 s cast time in the sources applies only to an enemy cast, which this driver never uses, so it is modeled with 0 cast time here).

Opening: at t=0 Q, W (self-cast Whimsy) and Help, Pix! are all off cooldown. Q is cast first since it has the only real cast time among them; W and E (both instant) then resolve, and Lulu auto-attacks and recasts Q, W and E on cooldown for the rest of the fight.

Pix, Faerie Companion fires its 3 bolts once per landed basic attack (applied after the attack's own damage, not per on-hit application), matching that Pix does not double up when other on-hit effects also trigger.

Glitterlance's two bolts (Lulu's full-value bolt and Pix's 50%-value bolt) are both assumed to connect with the stationary dummy: the open question about imperfect aim is settled toward ideal aim, the most common in-game reading against a single target.

Casting Help, Pix! on the dummy is read as sending Pix away from Lulu for the full 4 second enemy-cast duration, during which Pix's on-attack bolts do not fire; this is the settled reading of the ambiguous 'Pix leaves Lulu' mechanic.
Wild Growth deals no damage and only grants bonus health/slow, so it is never cast in this damage fight.
Mana is not modeled: at level 16 the combined Q/W/E costs over a 15 s fight fit comfortably inside Lulu's mana pool.

assumed.why: Whimsy's 0.2419 s cast time in the sources applies only to an enemy cast; this driver only ever self-casts Whimsy, which the dossier states has no cast time, so 0 is used.
